SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch. XXXXXXXX
REPORT
Date November 25, 1935.

Subject John Calvin West.

Made by and Forwarded by D.I. Ross.

John Calvin West, a citizen of the United States of America, was born in Texas, U.S.A., in 1872, of middle class people, who were able to afford their son a fairly good education. Little information is obtainable regarding his history prior to 1900, but the last 35 years has seen him in the Philippine Islands, where for 30 years (until about five years ago) he was holding a responsible and lucrative position with the Eastman Kodak Company.

West is a much married man, the present Mrs. West being his third wife. His first marriage was a failure the parties mutually separating after several years of strife and upsets. This lady is now residing in Texas with his (West's) parents, who are now both nonagenarians. His second marriage was a decided misalliance with a Filipino woman who bore him a couple of children. These children (a boy and a girl) - Eurasians - are now about 25 years of age and are living in Shanghai at present apart from their father. The son is reported to have a bad reputation.

The present Mrs. West was an intimate friend of West's before her marriage to him in Manila about 15 years ago, this being her second attempt at connubial bliss. West knew her previous husband in the Philippine Islands before his decease. She has a daughter (now 18) by her first marriage. Mrs. West, who is of pure Spanish descent, was brought up and educated in Madrid.

When West was drawing a big salary in the Philippine Islands with the Eastman Kodak Co. he never gave her a cent, so she had to run a Beauty Parlour in order to keep herself and the child, while he used to spend his time running around with

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别支部第二科。XXXXXXXX
报告
日期：1935年11月25日。

事由：约翰·卡尔文·韦斯特（John Calvin West）。

撰写及呈报人：巡官罗斯（D.I. Ross）。

约翰·卡尔文·韦斯特，美利坚合众国公民，1872年出生于美国德克萨斯州，出身中产阶级家庭，其父母有能力为其提供相当良好的教育。关于他1900年之前的经历，可获取的信息寥寥无几，但在过去35年里，他一直身处菲律宾群岛，在那里为伊士曼柯达公司（Eastman Kodak Company）担任责任重大且收入丰厚的职位长达30年（直至约五年前）。

韦斯特多次结婚，现任韦斯特夫人是他的第三任妻子。他的第一次婚姻以失败告终，双方在经历多年的争吵和动荡后协议分居。这位女士目前居住在德克萨斯州，与韦斯特的父母同住，其父母现均已年过九旬。他的第二次婚姻显然是一桩不般配的联姻，配偶是一名菲律宾女子，为他生下了两个孩子。这两个孩子（一男一女）——欧亚混血儿——现年约25岁，目前在上海生活，与其父亲分开居住。据称其子名声不佳。

现任韦斯特夫人在大约15年前于马尼拉与韦斯特结婚之前，曾是韦斯特的亲密朋友，这是她第二次尝试获得婚姻幸福。韦斯特在她前夫去世前曾在菲律宾群岛认识他。她与前夫育有一女（现年18岁）。韦斯特夫人拥有纯正的西班牙血统，在马德里接受抚养和教育。

当韦斯特在菲律宾群岛从伊士曼柯达公司领取高薪时，他从未给过她一分钱，因此她不得不经营一家美容院以维持自己和孩子的生活，而他则把时间花在与其他女人鬼混上。

West, following his arrival here from Manila, established,
in conjunction with H. G. Walter and Lawrence Snow, The
Anglo-American Photo Studio, Whiteaway-Laidlaw Building, 410
Szechuen Road. They later removed to 35 Jinkee Road when
shortly afterwards the business was sold to a Chinese concern.
Mrs. West, in order to support herself, opened a
private boarding house. In June, 1934, she took over the
Western Mansions, 941 Bubbling Well Road, which is leased
from the Spanish Fathers, one of whom was well known to
Mrs. West, with the result that things were made easy for her
when she rented the place. This individual was later
transferred up-country. She works hard at the Western
Mansions, but West never does a thing, he being kept in
comfort by his wife. She is said to be very unhappy and
would like to secure a separation. She is owed money all
over town, including $1,000 by Fred Barton. A number of the
guests residing at the Western Mansions are also in arrears
with their accounts. She has been visited by a representative
of the S.M.C. Revenue Department recently concerning her taxes
and she said that she would pay in installments. West is
always pestering her for money and is a constant drain on
her slender resources. She is on friendly terms with
P. Faison, American Attorney, 138 Kiukiang Road, who is
reported to be her legal adviser.

韦斯特从马尼拉抵达此处后，与H. G. 沃尔特（H. G. Walter）和劳伦斯·斯诺（Lawrence Snow）合作，在四川路410号惠罗大楼（Whiteaway-Laidlaw Building）建立了英美照相馆（The Anglo-American Photo Studio）。他们后来迁至静安寺路35号，不久后该业务被卖给了一家华商企业。
韦斯特夫人为维持生计，开设了一家私人寄宿公寓。1934年6月，她接手了位于静安寺路941号的西苑公寓（Western Mansions），该物业是从西班牙神父处租赁的，其中一位神父与韦斯特夫人熟识，因此她在租赁该场所时得到了便利。此人后来被调往内地。她在西苑公寓辛勤工作，但韦斯特从不做事，靠妻子供养过着舒适的生活。据说她非常不快乐，并希望达成分居。她在城里多处欠债，其中包括弗雷德·巴顿（Fred Barton）欠她的1,000美元。西苑公寓的许多住客也拖欠账目。最近，工部局捐务处的一名代表因税务问题拜访了她，她表示将分期付款。韦斯特总是向她索要钱财，不断消耗她微薄的资源。她与位于九江路138号的美国律师P. 费森（P. Faison）关系友好，据称费森是她的法律顾问。
（批：S2，请出示给市政律师 JAG 1935年11月27日）
（批：DS SB.）
（批：已出示给 T.I.A.，其复印了一份 D.B. Ross）

（批：归档 11月28日）

Shanghai, Nov. 5 1925
To S 2

Please report on

All inquiries should be
conducted very discreetly.
